source: Scooby L4D runtime feature registry. Hidden diagnostics and synthetic preview controls excluded.

items.label: Enable ESP
items.desc: Show visuals for entities supplied by the host.

items.label: Box
items.desc: Draw full or corner boxes around entity bounds.

items.label: Skeleton
items.desc: Connect the bone pairs supplied by the host.

items.label: Name
items.desc: Display the entity name above its bounds.

items.label: Health Bar
items.desc: Display health as a bar next to the entity.

items.label: Distance
items.desc: Show distance in the host's world units.

items.label: Snaplines
items.desc: Draw lines from the top, bottom or center of the screen to entity feet.

items.label: Radar
items.desc: Top-down positions from the shared entity data.

items.label: Survivors
items.desc: Show survivors in the entity snapshot.

items.label: Infected
items.desc: Show infected and special infected.

items.label: Fit to model
items.desc: Fit actor boxes to animated body hitboxes. Independent of the Skeleton switch.

items.label: Box padding (%)
items.desc: Extra space around the fitted body box.

items.label: Box width (%)
items.desc: Adjust actor ESP bounds; pickups keep their original size.

items.label: Box height (%)
items.desc: Adjust actor ESP bounds; pickups keep their original size.
